title: Pure Inca
summary: Rex Goodwin's Inca Synchro strategy built around the Sun Dragon Inti and Moon Dragon Quilla revival loop, updated with Ascator, Dawnwalker and Supay, Duskwalker. Each walker discards 1 card to Special Summon itself and its matching Tuner from the Deck for a 1-card Synchro Summon.

summary.title: Starters
points: Ascator, Dawnwalker discards 1 card to Special Summon itself (Level 5) in Defense Position and Special Summon Fire Ant Ascator (Level 3 Tuner) from your hand or Deck, locking your Extra Deck to Synchro Monsters for the turn.

Supay, Duskwalker discards 1 card to Special Summon itself (Level 5) in Defense Position and Special Summon Supay (Level 1 Tuner) from your hand or Deck, also locking your Extra Deck to Synchro Monsters for the turn.
Oracle of the Sun Special Summons itself from the hand as a Level 5 non-Tuner when only your opponent controls a monster, and Apocatequil becomes Level 5 while you control a Tuner.

summary.title: Opening: Ascator, Dawnwalker + Supay, Duskwalker
steps: Activate Ascator, Dawnwalker by discarding 1 card to Special Summon itself and Fire Ant Ascator from the Deck, then Synchro Summon Level 8 Sun Dragon Inti.
Activate Supay, Duskwalker by discarding 1 card to Special Summon itself and Supay from the Deck, then Synchro Summon Level 6 Moon Dragon Quilla.
With Moon Dragon Quilla in the GY and Sun Dragon Inti on the field (or vice versa), both celestial dragons are online to revive each other whenever destroyed.

summary.title: The Celestial Dragon Revival Loop
summary.text: When Sun Dragon Inti (3000 ATK) is destroyed by battle, it destroys the monster that destroyed it and inflicts burn damage equal to half that monster's ATK; if Sun Dragon Inti on the field is destroyed by battle or card effect, it Special Summons Moon Dragon Quilla from your GY during the next Standby Phase. When Moon Dragon Quilla (2500 ATK) is targeted for an attack, you gain LP equal to half the attacking monster's ATK; if Moon Dragon Quilla on the field is destroyed, it immediately Special Summons Sun Dragon Inti from your GY.

summary.title: Extra Deck & Support
points: Draco Berserker of the Tenyi can be Synchro Summoned using Level 6 Moon Dragon Quilla plus Level 2 Weeping Idol (which banishes a Tuner from the GY to Special Summon itself), or Level 1 Supay plus a Level 7 Synchro.
Destruct Potion destroys Sun Dragon Inti or Moon Dragon Quilla on your field as a Trap to gain 3000 or 2500 LP and immediately trigger Quilla's revival of Inti or set up Inti's Standby Phase revival.

Call of the Earthbound redirects an opponent's attack onto Inti or Quilla, Temple of the Sun grants +300 ATK to monsters Special Summoned from the GY, and Limit Reverse revives Fire Ant Ascator or Supay.

allow.Call of the Earthbound: Rex Goodwin's Trap that redirects an opponent's attack onto Sun Dragon Inti or Moon Dragon Quilla to force their destruction/revival loop.
allow.Temple of the Sun: Continuous Spell that boosts all monsters Special Summoned from the GY (your revived Sun Dragon Inti and Moon Dragon Quilla!) by 300 ATK.
allow.Destruct Potion: Normal Trap that destroys Sun Dragon Inti or Moon Dragon Quilla to gain LP equal to its ATK and trigger their GY revival loop during the opponent's turn.
allow.Limit Reverse: Continuous Trap that revives Fire Ant Ascator or Supay from your GY.
allow.Draco Berserker of the Tenyi: Generic Level 8 Synchro inside the Synchro-only lock (Quilla + Weeping Idol, or Supay + a Level 7); banishes a monster whose effect the opponent activates. Replaces Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon, Forbidden since October 2026.

main: Ascator, Dawnwalker

Core 1-card Sun Dragon Inti starter: discards 1 card to Special Summon itself from hand in Defense Position AND Special Summon 1 'Fire Ant Ascator' from your hand or Deck (Level 5 + Level 3 Tuner = Level 8 Sun Dragon Inti!).
Fire Ant Ascator
Required Level 3 EARTH Insect Tuner for Sun Dragon Inti, summoned directly from the Deck by Ascator, Dawnwalker.
Supay, Duskwalker

Core 1-card Moon Dragon Quilla starter: discards 1 card to Special Summon itself from hand in Defense Position AND Special Summon 1 'Supay' from your hand or Deck (Level 5 + Level 1 Tuner = Level 6 Moon Dragon Quilla!).
Supay

Required Level 1 EARTH Fiend Tuner for Moon Dragon Quilla, summoned directly from the Deck by Supay, Duskwalker, and Special Summons Oracle of the Sun from Deck when sent from field to GY by card effect.
Oracle of the Sun
Level 5 LIGHT Spellcaster: Special Summons itself from the hand if only your opponent controls a monster, and searches Fire Ant Ascator or Supay from your Deck when destroyed on the field.
Apocatequil
Level 4 LIGHT Thunder that automatically becomes Level 5 while you control a face-up Tuner (Fire Ant Ascator or Supay!), and revives Oracle of the Sun from your GY when destroyed on the field.
Weeping Idol
Level 2 DARK Rock that banishes 1 Tuner from your GY to Special Summon itself from your hand.
Call of the Earthbound
Trap that redirects an opponent's attack onto Sun Dragon Inti or Moon Dragon Quilla to force their destruction/revival loop.
Temple of the Sun
Continuous Spell that boosts all monsters Special Summoned from the GY by 300 ATK.
Destruct Potion
Normal Trap that destroys Sun Dragon Inti or Moon Dragon Quilla to gain LP equal to its ATK and trigger their GY revival loop during the opponent's turn!
Limit Reverse
Continuous Trap that revives Fire Ant Ascator or Supay from your GY.
extra: Signature Level 8 LIGHT Dragon Synchro boss ('Fire Ant Ascator' + 1+ non-Tuners; 3000 ATK): when destroyed by battle, destroys the monster that destroyed it and inflicts half that monster's ATK as burn damage; Special Summons Moon Dragon Quilla from GY during the next Standby Phase!

Signature Level 6 DARK Dragon Synchro boss ('Supay' + 1+ non-Tuners; 2500 ATK): gains LP equal to half the attacking monster's ATK when targeted for an attack; if destroyed on the field, immediately Special Summons 1 'Sun Dragon Inti' from your GY!
Generic Level 8 Synchro: banishes a monster whose effect the opponent activates.
